prompt: Create an RFP + RFQ event from an existing PR with 1 line item, invite 2 vendors and publish it. One vendor logs into the vendor portal, answers the technical sheet and quotes 95; for the other vendor the buyer enters a surrogate technical response and a surrogate bid of 100. End the bidding, then as the evaluator score both vendors' technical responses (8 and 6) and submit the evaluation. Then award the line to the lowest bidder in Master QCS.
